   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "861190d3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": "`STalign` relies on an interative gradient descent to align these two images. This performs quicker and better if the source and target are initially at a similar angle.\n\nEvaluate the similarity of the rotation angle by viewing a side by side comparison. Change the value of `theta_deg`, until the rotation angle is similar. Note: the rotation here is defined in degrees and is in the clockwise direction.\n\nThe angle chosen will be used to construct a 2x2 rotation matrix `L` and a 2 element translation vector `T`."
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "21f61800",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x13d331460>"
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 1200x1000 with 1 Axes>"
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": "theta_deg = 45\ntheta0 = (np.pi/180)*-theta_deg\n\n#rotation matrix \n#rotates about the origin\nL = np.array([[np.cos(theta0),-np.sin(theta0)],\n              [np.sin(theta0),np.cos(theta0)]])\n\nsource_L = np.matmul(L , np.array([xI, yI]))\nxI_L = source_L[0]\nyI_L = source_L[1]\n\n#translation matrix\n#effectively makes the rotation about the centroid of I (i.e the means of xI and yI]) \n#and also moves the centroid of I to the centroid of J\nT = np.array([ np.mean(xI)- np.cos(theta0)*np.mean(xI) +np.sin(theta0)*np.mean(yI) - (np.mean(xI)-np.mean(xJ)),\n              np.mean(yI)- np.sin(theta0)*np.mean(xI) -np.cos(theta0)*np.mean(yI) - (np.mean(yI)-np.mean(yJ))])\n\nxI_L_T = xI_L + T[0]\nyI_L_T = yI_L + T[1]\n\n\nfig,ax = plt.subplots()\nax.scatter(xI_L_T,yI_L_T,s=1,alpha=0.1, label='source with initial affine transformation')\nax.scatter(xJ,yJ,s=1,alpha=0.1, label = 'target')\nax.legend(markerscale = 10)"
